name: agentflow
description: Agent collaboration gates: task documents, inbound evaluation, and outbound review.

interface.shortDescription: Task documents, inbound evaluation gate, and outbound review gate.
interface.longDescription: Workflow skills for turning requirements into task documents, evaluating inbound work before executing it, and reviewing deliverables against the design. Delivery between panes is handled by the tmux plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use agentflow:task to turn this request into a structured task document.
Use tmux:tmux-dispatch to send this task to another tmux pane.
Use agentflow:gate-evaluate to sanity-check this inbound task before executing it.
